what: The Output list always requires kernels/clone_compute.cpp, even when the binding design is data-movement-only and rejects a compute stage (compute_passthrough). It also names the host file clone_program_descriptor.py, although Quasar ops are ProgramSpec ops and the examples call that file *_program_artifacts.py. The implementer has to decide which source governs.
suggest: Generate the Output list from the design: list a compute kernel only when the design has a compute stage, and name the host file after the target host program (<op>_program_artifacts.py for ProgramSpec).
